description: Laila autonomy rules — maps information channel signals to auto-executable actions

rules.description: Consulting-prospect decline detected — sender is the prospect's own company domain (keep this list in sync with active prospects in the pipeline)

trigger.sender_authentication: DKIM-aligned sender domain required (docs/security-model.md); a From-header substring match alone never fires a Tier 1 action
content_patterns: decided to go in another direction
not moving forward with the proposal
will not be proceeding with the engagement

actions.template: Career decline received from {company}. Pipeline stage updated to REJECTED.

rules.description: Discovery-call scheduling or pipeline advancement detected — sender is the prospect's own company domain (keep in sync with active prospects) or a scheduling tool

trigger.sender_authentication: DKIM-aligned sender domain required (docs/security-model.md); a From-header substring match alone never fires a Tier 1 action

rules.description: Propose calendar event when scheduling request detected in email
Create focus time blocks based on strategy allocation
Create reminders for follow-up items detected in comms

agent_queue.description: Items in the 'Laila' reminders list (see config/reminders-lists.json) are the agent task queue. Default classification is Tier 3 propose; only tasks whose leading verb is on this deterministic allowlist auto-execute as Tier 1.

1.name: Auto-Execute + Notify
1.description: Deterministic, low-risk, reversible. Execute immediately, log to audit, notify via the command channel.

tier_definitions._why_no_tier_2: Deliberately absent. The missing middle would be notify-first, act-on-timeout, which converts silence into consent. Consent here is expressed, never inferred from a timeout. Full reasoning: docs/security-model.md.

3.name: Propose-and-Wait
3.description: High-risk, irreversible, or visible to others. Propose in sync table, wait for explicit approval.
scope: Sending ANY communication (email, text message, chat)
Creating events with attendees or modifying existing events
Any action visible to people other than Alex
